title: In-context classification: Calibration and noise in linear attention with softmax readout
abstract: arXiv:2610.17061v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study in-context binary classification in a simple attention model trained to minimise a logistic loss. Each prompt has a latent logistic teacher, and the learner must infer its direction from Bernoulli-labeled context examples. We derive an asymptotic prediction for the test logit in a high-dimensional regime with context length proportional to token dimension, and total training prompts proportional to dimension squared. Our formula cleanly separates calibration, test-time context noise, and non-isotropic parameter-estimation noise as interpretable effects on in-context performance. Our analysis also identifies the ridgeless separability regime and addresses the effects of context length, pretraining-set size, regularisation, and sampling temperature on in-context classification performance. translated_title: 上下文分类：带softmax读出的线性注意力中的校准与噪声
translated_abstract: 我们研究了在一个简单的注意力模型中进行上下文二分类的问题，该模型通过最小化逻辑损失进行训练。每个提示（prompt）都包含一个潜在的逻辑教师（logistic teacher），学习者必须从带有伯努利标签的上下文示例中推断其方向。在上下文长度与词元维度成比例、训练提示总数与维度平方成比例的高维情形下，我们推导出了测试逻辑值（test logit）的渐近预测。我们的公式清晰地将校准、测试时上下文噪声以及非各向同性的参数估计噪声分离开来，作为对上下文性能的可解释影响。我们的分析还确定了无岭可分性（ridgeless separability）区域，并探讨了上下文长度、预训练集规模、正则化以及采样温度对上下文分类性能的影响。该理论的预测与有限维仿真以及完全训练的线性注意力模型高度吻合，同时实验……
tldr: 该论文针对线性注意力模型的上下文二分类任务推导出测试逻辑值的渐近解析公式，将校准误差、上下文噪声与参数估计噪声分离为可解释的独立效应，并系统分析了上下文长度、预训练规模、正则化和采样温度的影响，理论预测与仿真及真实训练模型高度吻合。
en_tdlr: This paper derives an asymptotic analytical formula for test logits in in-context binary classification with linear attention, cleanly separating calibration, context noise, and parameter-estimation noise as interpretable effects, and systematically analyzing the impact of context length, pretraining-set size, regularization, and sampling temperature, with predictions closely matching simulations and fully trained models.
